Name: /queue
Desc: send after the current turn ends (plain enter reaches a busy agent at its next step)

Name: /providers
Desc: manage providers: sign in with ChatGPT, Grok, the Z.ai Coding Plan or Kimi For Coding (enter) or sign out (ctrl+d); a name jumps to its sign-in

Name: /models
Desc: pick a model: enter sets the selected agent's, ctrl+s the channel default

Name: /variants
Desc: pick a model variant (reasoning effort) for the selected agent; no arg opens a picker

Name: /roles
Desc: pick the selected agent's role; a name sets it directly

Name: /mode
Desc: permission mode for the channel: ask, auto (free inside the channel's directories) or yolo

Name: /auto
Desc: auto mode: approve permissions inside the channel's directories, deny outside (no arg toggles)

Name: /yolo
Desc: yolo mode: approve every permission, directories included (no arg toggles)

Name: /channels
Desc: pick any channel across your working directories

Name: /dir
Desc: set this channel's default directory (or open its directories)

Name: /sandbox
Desc: the command sandbox: what bounds what agents run, what this machine cannot do, and the switch

Name: /web
Desc: Web UI: enable, disable or open it in a browser tab

Name: /discord
Desc: Discord status and connect/disconnect controls

Name: /rename
Desc: rename this channel (#name, unique across the daemon)

Name: /tree
Desc: toggle the agent sidebar (also ctrl+b)

Name: /chat
Desc: the channel chat: talk to every agent, @name addresses one (the sidebar opens an agent's own chat)

Name: /tokens
Desc: chart tokens over time: the selected chat's (the channel's, or the agent's), or the system's

Name: /cost
Desc: chart cost over time: the selected chat's (the channel's, or the agent's), or the system's

Name: /recap
Desc: ask the main agent for a status report after this many minutes without hearing from the channel (no arg reports the setting)

Name: /plan
Desc: chart a subscription's plan usage over time, as its own model calls reported it

Name: /history
Desc: load all of this channel's history (a chat opens with its most recent part)

Name: /compact
Desc: summarise the selected agent's completed turns now to free context (automatic at 80% of the window)

Name: /help
Desc: show or hide the key bar at the bottom (off by default)

Name: /settings
Desc: edit project or system config files
